title: Barroso Wispr
notes: Barroso Wispr — live voice dictation in Go: hold Left Ctrl + Left Alt, speak, release, and the text is pasted where the cursor is. Streams to the Gemini Live API through Barroso Keys (bk- keys) or Google AI Studio directly. Windows only for now. Set WISPR_API_KEY and run barroso-wispr-windows-amd64.exe. https://wispr.barroso.tec.br
